exclusions.source_text: ECOG performance status 0-1 (Karnofsky \> 60%, see Appendix A).
Total bilirubin ≤1.5 × institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)(or ≤2.0 x ULN in patients with documented Gilbert's Syndrome)
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤2.5 × institutional ULN or ≤5 × institutional ULN for participants with documented liver metastases
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT > 2.5 x ULN (or > 5 x ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Serum creatinine ≤1.5 × institutional ULN OR creatinine clearance ≥ 30 mL/min/ 1.73m2 for participants with creatinine levels above institutional ULN.
exclusions.threshold: creatinine > 1.5 x ULN or CrCl < 30 mL/min/1.73m2

exclusions.source_text: Known brain metastases that are untreated, symptomatic, or require therapy to control symptoms.
Individuals with a history of a second malignancy are ineligible except for the following circumstances.

HIV-positive participants are ineligible due to the potential for pharmacokinetic interactions of combination antiretroviral therapy with study drugs and the increased risk of fatal infections when treated with marrow-suppressive therapy.
Participant has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
participants who are breast-feeding are not eligible for enrollment.
